name: smwmusic-sonic-the-hedgehog-ms-gg-sky-base-zone
title: Sonic the Hedgehog (MS/GG) - Sky Base Zone
description:
The thrilling and short-but-sweet music that plays in Sky Base Zone in the 8-bit version of Sonic 1. Great for any fast-paced areas that are that happy kind of thrilling.

Also, since I had the channel space, this includes a version that's Yoshi drum-compatible! Make sure to use the correct version, since the channels cut for SFX is different (although probably not noticeable either way).

Requested by Mr Scotsman.
